item.name: Beginner Banner
item.cardSummary: Uses Beginner Tickets from the Beginner Path to build an early roster with better guaranteed value than the normal Gem banners.
item.poolStyle: Beginner-focused pool with guaranteed higher-tier value and no permanent featured target.
item.pityGuidance: Check the live banner counters before summoning.

item.name: Standard Banner
item.cardSummary: The broad ongoing summon pool for filling team roles and building a long-term roster after Beginner Tickets are gone.
item.poolStyle: General pool with multiple high-rarity possibilities; exact rates and units can change.
item.pityGuidance: Use the counter shown on this tab and read its current Rates details.

item.name: Mini Banner
item.cardSummary: A narrower summon option for chasing a featured Mythic instead of pulling from the wider Standard pool.
item.access: Summon area while a feature is active
item.poolStyle: Focused rotating pool built around a featured unit.
item.pityGuidance: Check the current feature, end time, and carry-over wording before spending.

item.name: Villain Banner
item.cardSummary: A separate event summon channel tied to Villain Invasion and paid with Villain Coins rather than the normal banner currencies.
item.poolStyle: Limited event pool; featured units and rates belong to the active event details.
item.pityGuidance: Treat any guarantee as event-specific and confirm it in the live panel.
